objective: A frozen exported model consistently beats both original Selfplay v2 and the unchanged scripted attacker.

guardrail_opponents.interceptor: training/scripts/env.py:scripted(obs, attack=False); reported, not a primary acceptance target

candidate_selection.data: Training seeds below 1,000,000,000; development seeds in [1,200,000,000,1,300,000,000).
candidate_selection.freeze: Before final evaluation, save candidate checkpoint and exported ONNX SHA256 plus the development selection evidence. Do not select or retune using holdout outcomes.
candidate_selection.previous_tests: Published v1/v2/v3 evaluation sets are diagnostic history, not fresh final evidence.

holdout.sampling: Three disjoint uint32 intervals; 200 unique dispersed seeds per block; fixed samplers 73, 74, 75.

evaluation.candidate: Actual exported ONNX through native ONNX Runtime, deterministic first argmax.
evaluation.learned_reference: Actual frozen selfplay-v2.onnx through native ONNX Runtime.
evaluation.scripted_reference: Unmodified deterministic attacker using only the six policy inputs.
evaluation.matches: Each seed: all five serves, both physical side assignments; aggregate ten-rally point margins.
evaluation.termination: Fixed v3 1,600-tick limit and exact post-contact loop detection for these fixed deterministic stateless controllers.

bootstrap.unit: whole seed: both sides and all five rallies remain together
intervals: mean rally point margin (wins minus losses per rally)
score_rate = wins plus half draws per rally

report: paired ten-rally match outcomes including draws

acceptance.scope: Every criterion must pass against both primary targets independently in each of all three holdout blocks.
acceptance.paired_match_win_rate: Strictly greater than 0.5, counting drawn matches in the denominator.
acceptance.point_margin_interval: Lower endpoint of seed-cluster 95% bootstrap confidence interval strictly greater than zero.
acceptance.side_fairness: Rally wins strictly exceed rally losses separately on left and right.
acceptance.failure: Report failure or mixed evidence honestly. Do not silently select another candidate on these same holdouts.
acceptance.interpretation: These are predeclared empirical acceptance thresholds, not a proof of optimal play or a family-wise statistical guarantee.
